_comment: EvoGuard-authored, NOT upstream. One benign string per user case, substituted for the '<Attacker Instruction>' placeholder in that case's Tool Response Template when the env serves the CLEAN arm. Written to read naturally in the slot each template puts it in (TwilioGetReceivedSmsMessages and TwitterManagerReadTweet embed it mid-sentence), so a clean observation is indistinguishable in shape from a poisoned one and the defender cannot win on formatting alone. Keyed by User Tool; the 17 user cases have 17 distinct user tools.
